caption: Vor Frue, Assens
composition: A red-brick basilica and an octagonal copper spire · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Vor Frue in Assens is a red-brick Gothic basilica in bare brick, with dark slate roofs and a west tower that is square below and octagonal above, finished with a copper spire. The square is empty. The night is clear, about 11.9°C. Moonlight reaches the ground under a thin cloud cover. The harbour basin is not in this frame.
